FROM "movie_keyword" mk

WHERE mk."id" < 3392948.0 AND k."keyword" = 'reference-to-diomedes'

sql:
SELECT t."id", kt."id", at."id"
FROM "title" t
JOIN "kind_type" kt ON t."kind_id" = kt."id"
JOIN "aka_title" at ON at."kind_id" = kt."id"
WHERE t."episode_nr" < 34.0 AND kt."kind" = 'video game'
description: auto-generated 3-way join over title, kind_type, aka_title

SELECT ci."id", pi."id", it."id"
FROM "cast_info" ci
JOIN "person_info" pi ON ci."person_id" = pi."id"
JOIN "info_type" it ON pi."info_type_id" = it."id"
JOIN "movie_info_idx" mii ON mii."info_type_id" = it."id"
WHERE ci."nr_order" > 3.0 AND pi."note" = '**'
description: auto-generated 4-way join over cast_info, person_info, info_type, movie_info_idx
